wrong_enzyme.canonical_diagnosis: The chosen enzyme was incompatible with the BsaI-flanked substrates; Golden Gate-01 requires BsaI or BsaI-HFv2.
acceptable_variants: Golden Gate-01 must use BsaI for the supplied BsaI-flanked substrates.
BsaI or BsaI-HFv2 is required because the supplied substrates contain BsaI sites.

wrong_ligase.canonical_diagnosis: A non-T4 ligase was used; Golden Gate cycling requires T4 DNA ligase co-incubation with the Type IIS enzyme.
acceptable_variants: T4 DNA ligase is required for Golden Gate cycling; the chosen ligase is not compatible.
Only T4 DNA ligase ligates cohesive ends at 16 C during Golden Gate cycling.

wrong_fragment_count.canonical_diagnosis: Fragment count did not match the four-fragment Golden Gate-01 design (1 backbone + 3 inserts).
acceptable_variants: Golden Gate-01 requires all four fragments (backbone plus three inserts).
The assembly did not include the expected four fragments.

wrong_thermal_program.canonical_diagnosis: The thermal program was incompatible; Golden Gate-01 requires 30 cycles of 37 C digestion and 16 C ligation.
acceptable_variants: Use the cited 30-cycle 37 C / 16 C Golden Gate program.
The digestion temperature, ligation temperature, or cycle count did not match the Golden Gate-01 program.

wrong_buffer.canonical_diagnosis: The one-pot buffer was incompatible; Golden Gate-01 requires an ATP-containing T4 DNA ligase reaction buffer.
acceptable_variants: Use T4 DNA ligase buffer so both BsaI and T4 DNA ligase remain active.
The selected buffer did not support one-pot restriction and ligation.
